hypothesis: For the four observed reality-check questions, a plain single-shot OpenCaseLaw /decisions search (baseline, no query-map/counter-authority machinery) retrieves at least one frozen controlling authority per question-with-a-frozen-set in each of FR/DE/IT top-50, and an explicit counter/limiting pass reaches known counter authority; if it does not, the product's observed authority failures are retrieval-side, not answer-side.
baseline: one plain OpenCaseLaw /decisions call per (question, language, channel); no lexicon expansion, no reranking, no citation-neighbourhood expansion (lane directive: baseline = the same OpenCaseLaw search/result set without the additional query-map/counter-authority machinery)
metrics_pinned: norm::retrievable::<slug> (>=1 retrieved row text contains a frozen norm token)
counter::limiting_marker_verified::<slug> (>=1 counter-channel row with norm AND limitation token)
source::rows_valid::<slug> (decision_id, https mcp.opencaselaw.ch canonical_url, language in de/fr/it)
duplicate::unique_ids::<slug> (alnum-core unique within a query response)
success_rule: exit 0 only when every measurable gate passes; a falsifying failure is exit 1 with the record preserved; not_measurable gates carry an explicit reason and never count as passes
claim_ceiling: retrieval/counter reachability and integrity of independent OpenCaseLaw searches; no UX claim, no supporting/contrary label is assigned by this benchmark
pre_freeze_disclosure: two schema probes with a NON-frozen query (Konventionalstrafe Vertragsstrafe, limit 3 and 50) and one generic probe (query=business judgment rule, limit 3, first 400 chars read) were made BEFORE this record to establish response shape/size/latency. No frozen query text was executed and no frozen authority-hit determination was made before this record was written. An exploratory scan of the ACCEPTED product query_cache preceded the design of the exploratory product-cache comparison, which is therefore labelled EXPLORATORY in the run record and is NOT a claim-bearing gate.

derived_from.counter_ids_source: accepted /tmp/lex_accepted/product/results/product/reality_check/*.json cited_decisions rows with counter_status in COUNTER_STATUSES
